card.description: Select one or more charge cards to expose as switches in Home Assistant. You may leave all cards unchecked if you do not want to configure any charge cards at this time.

data.confirm_ownership: I hereby confirm that the selected charge card(s) are in my possession and that I am the owner.

reauth_confirm.title: Re-authenticate with 50five
reauth_confirm.description: Please enter your password for account {username}.

error.cannot_connect: Cannot connect to GraphQL API endpoint

init.title: 50five options
init.description: Select one or more charge cards to expose as switches in Home Assistant.

data.confirm_ownership: I hereby confirm that the selected charge card(s) are in my possession and that I am the owner.

error.must_confirm_ownership: You must confirm ownership of the selected charge card(s) to proceed

start_charging.name: Start charging
start_charging.description: Start a charging session with an optional RFID card ID.

card_id.name: RFID card ID
card_id.description: Optional RFID card ID to use for this charging session. If not provided, uses the targeted card switch's card or the first configured card.

get_transactions.name: Get transactions
get_transactions.description: Fetch recent completed charging transactions for a charge station.

limit.name: Limit
limit.description: Maximum number of transactions to return (1-50).

date_from.name: Date from
date_from.description: Start of the date range to search (inclusive). Must not be more than 1 month before date_to; defaults to 1 month before date_to.

date_to.name: Date to
date_to.description: End of the date range to search (inclusive). Defaults to the current time (or 1 month after date_from if date_from is more than 1 month ago).

no_valid_targets.message: No valid 50five charging entities were targeted.

invalid_date_range.message: The start date (date_from) must not be after the end date (date_to).

date_range_too_long.message: The requested date range must not exceed 1 month.
